Speech AI Models: TTS, STT, Speech to Speech, and LLM
Four capabilities, seven models. Pick one and go.
Ask a question|Copy page|View as Markdown|More actions
One API key, one base URL, four things you can do with speech and language.
Text to Speech
Stream natural speech with Lightning at 44.1 kHz and 200 ms to first byte.
Lightning v3.1 ProLightning v3.1
Speech to Text
Transcribe live or recorded audio with Pulse, 21 streaming languages.
Pulse 2.0PulsePulse Pro
Speech to Speech
Talk to Hydra over one WebSocket, audio in and audio out.
Hydra
LLM
Run Electron, an OpenAI-compatible model built for voice agents.
Electron
The models
Text to speech
Lightning v3.1 Pro
Premium voices, 31 languages. New checkpoint in preview for English, Spanish and Hindi.
Lightning v3.1
217 voices, cloning, 12 languages.
Speech to text
Pulse 2.0
English streaming, built-in turn detection, emotion, and gender.
Pulse
Streaming and batch, 21 streaming languages.
Pulse Pro
English batch, leaderboard accuracy.
Speech to speech
Hydra
Full-duplex speech to speech.
LLM
Electron
Chat completions, 70 languages.
